_comment: What the campaign's arms EXECUTE differently, declared BEFORE any paper cell (incident-graph-ladder-confound-20260916, rule 1). verify_execution_differences.py reads every arm's boot snapshot and refuses the campaign on any difference not listed here. Values are per arm; a field absent from an arm's entry must be equal across all arms.

upstream.reason: literal SGLang default ladder on 80 GB (T1 column)

vskipper.reason: design: the fork captures 4x max_bs (vpipe/common.py); its router/projector weights shrink the K/V pool by <1.5 % (against the treatment) [D-849, 2026-09-21: regime switch version 2 -- each request is pinned to ONE body (stock or routed) at admission from the decode band state and keeps it for prefill and every decode step; a decode step carrying both pins is partitioned into two uniform sub-passes; the radix prefix cache is namespaced by body (|vpbody=<pin> in the extra key). Bands unchanged.]

Bands unchanged.]

_comment_decode_kv_band: fork arms: 'rule' = the live regime-switch K/V band must equal roofline.derived_kv_band for the device the gate is told it runs on (per-device table SERVED_DECODE_KV_BAND_BY_DEVICE, every entry a rule output; A100 keyed by memory class); 'shared' = the arm attests decode_kv_band_policy shared (a declared deviation, D-778 Qwen posture). Absent for a fork arm = refused.
